name: Textual
description: Python framework for terminal and web user interfaces.
summary: AI-generated PRs are accepted if they say they are AI-generated, name the agent, fill in the PR template and link to a solution a maintainer approved.

evidence.quote: This project accepts AI generated Pull Requests, as long as the following guidelines are met.
The Pull Request must identify itself as AI generated, including the name of the agent used.
The Pull Request must link to a issue or discussion where a solution has been approved by a maintainer
